title: ID0389800-DC/Si-D/FR[4HIbKg & znOp3r] - Impact on Scheduling
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
vehicles are no longer charging fully
Root cause:
2 things here, first they didnt authenticate in a specific session and the other is about VOlvo trucks charging when there is already another EV in paralel.
Solution:
Close and refer to ID0390475
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
No
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: eTrucks Charging Issue - Impact on Scheduling
additional_info.body:
Hello,
This morning at 6:50 a.m., I received multiple SMS notifications indicating that all vehicles are no longer charging fully. This is becoming increasingly challenging for managing our schedules.
After a quick check, here are the details of the two chargers involved:
1.    Charger 1
•     Reference: MP/R6 170002081
2.    Charger 2: Sicharge D
•     Serial Number: MP/R6 170002001
•     Charger ID: 4HIbKg
Charging details for etruck GM 146 YY:
•     Charging period:
•     From 13/11/2024 18:28:56 to 13/11/2024 19:43:23
•     Connection time: from 13/11/2024 18:28:16 to 13/11/2024 19:43:24
•     Charging duration: 1h14m26s
•     Energy consumption: 248.83 kWh
•     Start meter reading: 65,007.4
•     End meter reading: 65,256.3
Additionally, the client has noted a recurring issue: why does the charge consistently cut off after just 10 minutes when connecting their trucks?
Could this be related to the recent update of the ÉCOG timeout settings? We’re also wondering if the delayed firmware update for Ready2Run—which has been awaited for over two years—might be contributing to these charging interruptions, as it was expected to arrive but still hasn’t.
Please include Sébastien Collet and Francisco de Matos Joaquim in the discussion. We would appreciate your urgent attention to this matter and any possible solutions to ensure our equipment functions optimally.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0389800-DC/Si-D/FR[4HIbKg & znOp3r] - Impact on Scheduling CRM:00315002053
additional_info.body:
Hi,
The issue of charging session interruption is clearly confirmed. I personally initiated a session, limiting the power to 40 kW on DC2 (SiD 300 kW). However, this morning, I noticed that the charge stopped at a SOC of 45%.
Session details:
•     Start timestamp: 14/11/2024 18:46:02
•     End timestamp: 14/11/2024 20:29:25
•     Connected from: 14/11/2024 18:45:29
•     Connected until: 15/11/2024 07:59:09
•     Charging duration: 01:43:22
•     Total connected time: 01:43:22
•     Initial meter reading: 48,668.2
•     Final meter reading: 48,751.6
•     Energy consumption: 83.36 kWh
This clearly indicates that an issue persists regarding the premature termination of charging sessions. A detailed analysis is required to identify and resolve this anomaly.
Best regards,

additional_info.body:
Hello Sebastien and Malek, good morning. I hope you are doing alright.
Yes, Sebastien, you are correct. I believe the tickets I took care of, were related to ERR69 which needed the hotfix for the Modbus communication.
This is a new error which is related to a very specific group of EVs where the PilotState is not transmitted correctly. I know by heart 2 EVs that we are currently facing issues and are under investigation by myself as well, which are, Daimler and Mercedes eActros 600.
Can you tell me the EV brand of this session?
The R&D is already implementing a new update for this specific error which comes out in V6.1.X.
For now the best I can do is keep you updated if there is any news but this version is estimate to come out in Frebruary 2025.
Let me know your thoughts and questions.
Best regards,
Francisco

Thanks for the quick feedback.
Yes, indeed the Volvo FME trucks also had this issue some months ago. Me and a colleague of mine did a specific Vehicle Integration for this specific model and found there were 2 different problems related to the EV itself and not our charger:
Update of truck's FW
